name: dynsodyn
description: Shared libc SP4: dynso linked dynamically and bound on the machine (crt0_dyn, libc's binder): libcso's checks, a pointer cell, &errno, a far helper, the carve below the copied core, an environment variable, libc's resident banks under the patched pointer cell, an exec of a dynamic dyntrue; then libc's user count back to what it was before, which counts the dynamic daemons the boot started.  The marker is built by expansion, and the first look's own line, `LDC look users=', is shown so the probe cannot pass on two identical ldctl failures.
command: L=LDC; /testbin/ldctl look libc > /tmp/u0; DSO_ENV=yes /testbin/dynsodyn; /testbin/ldctl look libc > /tmp/u1; cmp /tmp/u0 /tmp/u1 && echo $L-users-same; cat /tmp/u0
